item.title: Making Your Listening Easier

item.title: New Release: John-Eric Booth
item.description: John-Eric Booth - Alive & SwingingHere's an album I've lived with through various mixes and versions. It is finally out and ready for its closeup. I often kid about John-Eric being my favorite crooner from West Virginia, but the fact is simple: He "gets" it. He got into the business late, but is a quick learner and a swing historian, too. item.title: Quick Notes on Social Networking
item.description: A month or so, I thought I'd move our Facebook group The Penthouse Radio over to a "fan page" to make it easier to update. Of course, Facebook doesn't allow you to just change the page type and keep people who joined up (that would be too easy).
